out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) 1DR prep top, Raw beef cooler was observed at 70f
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER UNTIL IT IS OPERATIONAL.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the hot water at the 3 compartment sink was observed at 94-95f.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. ENSURE THE HOT WATER IS AT A MINIMUM OF 110f. PLEASE CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved “Y” splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION FOR THE APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICES. PLEASE ORDER AND INSTALL.
